utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday, 11 February. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Sorry, just sat down. The traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely, isn't it? I'm meant to be going walking at the weekend, but looking at this weather, my weekend plans might just be the sofa.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Probably get further on the sofa than I did in the car.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. There's a birthday cake in the office, by the way. Already there, before anyone adds cake procurement to the list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Finally, a job with decent materials availability.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Behave. Fi, anything closed out before we get into the live stuff?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, signed off the inspection on the fire panel on Tuesday. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And signed off the inspection on the stretch wrapper on Tuesday as well. Both closed, not carry-overs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. I signed off the inspection on the line 3 chiller on Tuesday too. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On the stretch wrapper, I noticed it was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, are you saying there's something outstanding against that inspection?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, no—just an observation. Settled down, nothing new to action from me.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same sort of thing, I heard a slight rattle from the IM3. Nothing to action yet, just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Understood. Not turning every noise in the building into a work order, then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the line 2 interlock, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine. Closed items, observations and that deferred belt all stay off today's action list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you inspect the GT1 fuel valve for leaks by Monday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Monday is the deadline, but first in the queue because of the production hold, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Monday isn't an invitation to leave it sitting there. It needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. I'll inspect the GT1 fuel valve for leaks, first in my queue, by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya, can you run a function test on the line 1 TCU by Wednesday? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: By Wednesday—we're talking today, aren't we?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today. That's the Wednesday deadline, and drop everything for it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, accepted. I'll run a function test on the line 1 TCU by Wednesday. That's my immediate priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, clear. That's not one buried halfway down the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya, can I also give you scheduling downtime for the palletizer with production, at half two? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, no, I can't take that as well. Not with the function test you've just put first. That'd be me saying yes and then dropping it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fair enough. Sarah Okafor, can that come back to you, then—schedule downtime for the palletizer with production at half two?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take it instead of Priya. I'll schedule downtime for the palletizer with production at half two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that still stands.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And half two is when you're doing the scheduling, not us announcing that the machine stops at half two?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Scheduling with production. We haven't agreed the actual downtime slot here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While we're on half two, I'll grease and check the bearings on the GT2 at half two.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over you. Bearings at half two, did you say?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll grease and check them at half two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip is how I'm treating that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi. The GT2 bearings are yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Planner with a grease gun. The spreadsheet's going to get fingerprints.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: It'll survive. Might improve some of the numbers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you swap the filter on the AC1 today? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll swap the filter on the AC1 today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Was that another half-two one, or—sorry, the audio clipped.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, today for that one, no particular clock time. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Got it. Today, and it stays on my list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you go to Tollgate to pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 barrel by the end of the week? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so get straight onto that, with the collection completed by the end of the week? Not wait until the end of the week to start.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Safety critical, straight away. By the end of the week is the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll go to Tollgate to pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 barrel. Straight onto it, completed by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's separate from the guarding item, isn't it? Don't want those getting bundled together.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is. I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 3 by the end of the week. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got that, Saz. Guarding is yours, by the end of the week, and not the same urgency as the parts.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Two separate things, different priorities.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Before we get too far, I still can't get to the water booster until production gives us a window. That's a blocker, not me volunteering for anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. I'll replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump after lunch. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just to be clear, though, we haven't got that production window confirmed. After lunch isn't confirmed access.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, I'm not saying the blocker's cleared. I'll own the seal replacement, with after lunch as the planned timing, subject to that access. Safety critical, straight away once we can get in—not a casual job to leave sitting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So Sarah owns the Water Booster Pump seals, after lunch, and the access blocker stays visible. Not marked ready when it isn't.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, that's the honest version.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Was there a controls item for next week as well? I lost the thread when Teams froze.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 water valve next week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah Okafor against the GT2 water valve sensor recalibration, next week. That's you taking it, yes?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do that next week.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, distinct from the bearings. Same machine label floating about, different bit of kit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. No bundling those together either.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. And the weather's somehow got worse while we've been talking.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sofa weekend looking stronger by the minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cheers everyone. That's the stand-up. Cake's in the office, rain's everywhere else.
